difficulty_reason: The counted proposition is the author proposition at source lines 1679-1684: for a primitive recursive set of sentences Gamma, the relation Prf_Gamma(x, y) saying that x codes a natural deduction derivation of the sentence with Godel number y whose undischarged assumptions all lie in Gamma is primitive recursive. The author proof (1686-1700) assembles it from the unit's derivability predicate Deriv, the end-formula and open-assumption functions, the primitive recursive membership predicate R_Gamma, and bounded quantification over subderivations; writing the definition and checking that every ingredient is primitive recursive in the right sense is the counted work, with the derivability predicate delegated to the unit's own lemma.
